primaryChecks.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
